title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.60
subtitle: Garments that start in the body are pulled out.

highlights.title: Starts clean
highlights.description: Cloth that starts inside the body or other cloth is pulled out at the start of an AETHER bake instead of tearing.

highlights.title: Gravity Forces with AETHER
highlights.description: Scenes with a Force object that only provides gravity run with the AETHER Engine; wind is reported clearly.

highlights.title: Smooth updates
highlights.description: Add-on updates no longer fail while the Companion or an AETHER simulation is running.
